name: minecraft-map-codex-translator
description: Java Edition Minecraft map localization workflows for Codex, with resource-pack-first export and optional copied-map patching.

interface.shortDescription: Localize Minecraft maps with context-aware Codex workflows.
interface.longDescription: Minecraft Map Translator guides Codex through professional Java Edition map localization: scan text, preserve commands and formatting, build glossary and context, use the user-requested target locale, prefer non-invasive resource-pack output, and only patch copied world data when explicitly requested.
defaultPrompt: Use $mc-map-translate to localize this Java map to my target locale.
Use $mc-map-translate to build a resource-pack translation export.
Use $mc-map-translate to QA an MC map translation workpack.
